data.title: Euna Solutions Announces Winners of 2026 Euna Impact Awards
data.description: Euna Solutions®, a top provider of cloud-based software for the public sector, revealed 10 recipients of the 2026 Euna Impact Awards at their annual customer conference, Eunaverse 2026, in Austin, Texas from September 14-16. These awards recognize public sector entities leveraging technology to enact positive transformations, enhance efficiency, and achieve superior results. This marks the second year of the awards ceremony, showcasing organizations making notable impacts through innovative tech solutions.

data.title: US House tax package excludes mining, staking reward deferment. The 114-page bill alters crypto fee, stablecoin, lending tax. Reward-tax timing unchanged.
data.description: The 114-page legislation proposes altering the tax treatment of cryptocurrency fees, stablecoins, and lending. It also suggests keeping the current timing for reward tax unchanged.

data.title: Praxent Strengthens Board as Financial Services Races to Move AI From Pilots to Production
data.description: Praxent, headquartered in Austin, Texas, has recently appointed three new members to its board to enhance the scaling of AI transformation for financial services companies. These new additions aim to support firms as they transition from pilot stages to full production.

data.title: Cleveland Cavaliers Games Return to Free Over-the-Air Television  on Gray Media Stations
data.description: A 15-game regular season package will now be simulcasted on WOIO, WUAB, and Rock Entertainment Sports Network. These games will also be available alongside the Cavaliers on the DAZN subscription platform. This initiative aims to reach a wider audience and provide access to these games across different networks and platforms.

data.title: Study: Rising costs force U.S. restaurants to raise menu prices, delay critical equipment upgrades
data.description: In Dallas, a recent study by SilverChef USA revealed significant challenges for U.S. hospitality operators due to escalating expenses and disruptions in the supply chain. Approximately 68% of operators have increased menu prices in the last year, with 30% intending to implement further increases. This trend reflects the ongoing adjustments within the industry as operating costs surge. The study also suggests that operators are adapting by altering their investment strategies in equipment, indicating a broader restructuring throughout the sector.

data.title: Transocean Ltd. Announces $80 Million Contract For Ultra-Deepwater Drillship
data.description: In Steinausen, Switzerland, on September 15, 2026, Transocean Ltd. (NYSE: RIG) revealed that the Deepwater Conqueror secured a two-well contract in Equatorial Guinea with an operator whose identity remains confidential. The contract entails a 170-day campaign starting in 2027 right after the rig completes its existing contract in the U.S. Gulf. This new project is projected to generate around $80 million in backlog for Transocean, which excludes extra services and fees related to mobilization and demobilization.

data.title: Bringg Appoints Jeff Eissinger as Senior Vice President and General Manager, North America
data.description: A company in Chicago, Bringg, has appointed Jeff Eissinger as Senior Vice President and General Manager for North America. Eissinger will oversee sales and customer success in the company's biggest region, with a focus on commercial strategy and executive engagement. With over 20 years of experience in operations, supply chain, technology, and customer experience, Eissinger's most recent role was Vice President.

data.title: RTA Fleet Named No. 34 on Fortune Best Small Workplaces™ 2026 List
data.description: In Glendale, Arizona, RTA: The Fleet Success Company, a provider of fleet management software and consulting services for public-sector and enterprise fleets, was ranked at No. 34 on the Fortune Best Small Workplaces™ 2026 list by Great Place To Work®. This marks a significant jump from their position at No. 83 in 2023. The CEO of RTA Fleet, Josh Turley, sees this achievement as a confirmation of the intentional effort the company has put into shaping its culture. According to Turley, fostering a positive workplace culture is a crucial aspect that can significantly impact a company's success.

data.title: Personetics Launches Banking Console, Bringing AI-Powered Customer Intelligence to the Relationship Manager's Desktop
data.description: Personetics, a leading AI Cognitive Banking Platform based in New York, has introduced a new product called Banking Console. This innovative AI-powered tool is designed to assist bankers in analyzing customer behavior, preferences, and financial indicators comprehensively. By integrating this intelligence into the banks' existing CRM systems, Banking Console transforms stagnant customer data into dynamic insights for enhanced engagement. Relationship managers (RMs), who typically handle numerous customer portfolios with time constraints, can benefit significantly from this proactive and value-driven solution.

data.title: Approov Named Gold Sponsor of Cloudflare Connect 2026
data.description: Approov Limited, a prominent player in mobile app attestation and mobile API security, has disclosed its participation as a Gold Sponsor at Cloudflare Connect 2026, a noteworthy conference set to be held from October 19 to 21, 2026, at Moscone West in San Francisco. The company will have a notable presence throughout the event, spanning all three days, and will also be involved in the Global Partner Summit scheduled for October 19. Since their partnership commenced in 2024, Approov and Cloudflare have collaborated to address a deficiency present in web-oriented defenses that were not designed to accommodate certain types of threats.
